fusions.name: Bagged Head
fusions.desc: Throws a sack over the first enemy it meets, dealing 11 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Rug Pull
fusions.desc: Yanks the cloth from under everything in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 8 damage with a 60% chance to leave each target [Leaden] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Turned Lining
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Hollow Coat
fusions.desc: Conjures a loose coat on you: every hit you take is reduced by 1, your armour rises by 6% and your dodge chance rises by 6%.
